title: Line-based plans layout plans/<exam>/<line>/runs/<id>, solve --line, safe plans migration with dry-run/backup/undo (REQ-0098)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 --line default main, resolver reads old/REQ-0095/new layouts
AC3 run-history and run.json references keep working
AC4 explicit reviewed mapping incl. non-exam folders
AC5 shared per-exam cache, run-list grouped by line with subject column
AC6 tests, dry-run reviewed by the user before --apply, QA recount before/after

design.summary: runlayout LINE_DEFAULT main, new_plan_run(root, exam, line, subject), resolver over old/REQ-0095/new layouts; solve --line and --exam-id; exam plans-migrate dry-run/apply/undo with backup, MIGRATION.json, history rewrite (50 plan_dir lines), alias by old plan_run_id; run-list/run-compare/run-stats resolve EXAM/LINE/ID and old ids; shared per-exam cache; reports mirror reports/<exam>/<line>/run-<id>; real tree: 50 plan runs, 41 move, 9 stay; real --apply only after the user reviews the dry-run

implementation.summary: line-based layout plans/<exam>/<line>/runs/<id>[-subject] with --line and --exam-id; resolver over old/REQ-0095/new layouts; exam plans-migrate --dry-run/--apply/--undo (backup, MIGRATION.json, history rewrite, rollback, resume); run-list/compare/stats by EXAM/LINE/ID; reports mirror; dry-run map 154 moves, 0 unmapped; scratch round trip equal (1597 files, 22166666 bytes, 41/41 plan.json sha256, 208/208 history paths, run-list rows 13/13); real plans/ untouched

unit_test.result: gate: ran 1834, new=[], known=4, gate_ok true, 366.3 s, worktree removed; test_plansmigrate 39, test_runlayout 57; --fast 1814 tests only the 4 known

security.result: os.rename inside plans/ only, backup outside the root verified before any move, map entries confined to plans/, no shell; undo via MIGRATION.json or the backup; verifier security pass clean

verification.command: python3 -I scripts/exam.py plans-migrate --dry-run, --apply --backup-dir work/backups (user: apply), --verify; recounts; gate --full
verification.result: real apply: 41 runs, 111 files, 2 caches moved, 41 history lines rewritten; --verify 15 checks 0 failed; files 1597->1599 and bytes +305319 exactly MIGRATION.json + .bak + history growth; plan.json sha256 50/50 equal; backup holds all 874 moved files with equal sizes; 41 run-list rows after equal the status/cost/line of the old plan.json read from the backup (0 mismatches; the first before-capture was garbled and was replaced by this recount); gate ran 1834, new=[], known=4

user_notes.note: Q1-Q4 best; plans conversion OK with dry-run reviewed before apply; pack REQ-0094 after the layout
